decision: Keep Docling as an explicitly optional structured-document backend. Do not make it the reference default or a mandatory rung: the disposable footprint was material and no quality advantage was measured in this closure pass. Re-open with a bounded page run when a real source requires structure beyond direct parsing and OCR.
boundary_implication: The Processor boundary must support optional structured/layout backends, but does not require Docling-specific types, models, or installation at freeze time.
